title: Houthis Reported to Have Attacked Saudi Arabia's Largest Oil Refinery
detail: Semafor reported that Yemen's Houthis attacked Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery. Only the headline was available at the time of writing: the facility, weapons used, damage and casualties are not yet confirmed, and the report has not been independently verified.

title: Yemen Says Houthis Attacked Aden Airport Twice with Ballistic Missiles
detail: Yemen's government said the Houthis attacked Aden airport twice with ballistic missiles. Only the headline was available at the time of writing: the timing, damage and casualties are not yet confirmed, and the claim has not been independently verified.

title: Report: Russian Satellite Data Helped Houthis Target Saudi Arabia
detail: A report says Russian satellite data helped Yemen's Houthis target Saudi Arabia. Only the headline was available at the time of writing: the original outlet, evidence and any official response are not yet confirmed, and the claim has not been independently verified.
